name: Derived line excluded from standard manual + partner discount
expected: A derived maintenance line (ItemIsDerived__std=true) on a partner deal must be EXCLUDED from the standard Manual Quote Level Discount (V21 step 85 filter) and standard Partner Discount (V21 step 89 filter) and handled ONLY by the derived-maintenance variants (Manual Discount - Derived Maintenance step 83; Partner Discount - Derived Maintenance steps 92/93), so each discount is applied exactly once (no double-discount). Concretely: derived value x (1 - partner%) once, and x (1 - manual%) once.
